_cuisine_preferences_note: Array — household can be a mix. Set during onboarding. Used to order the dish quick-pick screen (matching cuisines surface first) and as a soft scoring boost in suggestions (same food_class + matching cuisine scores slightly higher). Does NOT filter out other cuisines — user can add any dish. Engine matches any overlap: if household is [up_bihari, hyderabadi], a dish with cuisine [up_bihari, punjabi] still matches. Editable in Settings → Household.
notes: Shared carbs and sabzi. Protein recommended separately per diet_type. Eggitarian persons get egg-based proteins alongside veg proteins. Each component independently swappable. Guests handled by temporarily adding personas — no special guest mode.
